title: Relative differentials are invariant under etale localization
statement:
Let
$$
\begin{array}{ccc}
X_2 & \xrightarrow{a} & X_1\\
\downarrow && \downarrow\\
S_2 & \xrightarrow{b} & S_1
\end{array}
$$
be a commutative square of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with both $a:X_2\to X_1$ and $b:S_2\to S_1$ etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Let $f:X_1\to S_1$ and $f_2:X_2\to S_2$ be the vertical morphisms, and let $\Omega^1_{X_1/S_1}$ and $\Omega^1_{X_2/S_2}$ be their relative differential sheaves with universal derivations [def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf]. The canonical $\mathcal O_{X_2}$-linear map
$$a^*\Omega^1_{X_1/S_1}\longrightarrow\Omega^1_{X_2/S_2},\qquad 1\otimes da_1\longmapsto d(a^\sharp a_1),$$
induced by functoriality of Kähler differentials and ordinary module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], is an isomorphism. It carries the pulled-back universal derivation to the universal derivation on $X_2/S_2$ and is compatible with restriction to open subschemes.

proof.text: Mathlib already supplies SmoothOfRelativeDimension 0 for an etale morphism. Apply [lem-sc-smooth-omega-finite-locally-free] at rank zero to a and b. The rank-zero consequence of [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module], implemented by the proved source-library theorem Modules.isZero_of_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_zero, gives IsZero for both relative differential sheaves. The explicit fibre-dimension assertion is not needed.

source.place: Tag 04BX, proof, opening recall; rank-zero justification: morphisms.tex Tag 02G1

proof.text: Apply [lem-a1-differential-sheaf-transitivity-exact] to X2 -> S2 -> S1, retaining its second arrow q and its formula on differentials. The adjunction [def-pc-module-pullback] identifies maps from f2^* Omega(S2/S1) with maps from the zero sheaf Omega(S2/S1), so its first arrow is zero. Exactness therefore makes q mono, and its recorded epimorphism makes q an isomorphism in the abelian module category.

Apply [lem-sfb-smooth-differential-transitivity-short-exact] to X2 -> X1 -> S1, using the Mathlib smooth instance for the etale map a. Its last term Omega(X2/X1) is zero by step 1. ShortExact.isIso_f_iff gives that p = f1.relativeDifferentialsPullbackMap a is an isomorphism.

Compose p, relativeDifferentialsCongr for the square equation, and q. The defining formula of p [def-a1-relative-differentials-pullback-map] and the formula of q prove the displayed differential formula. For any source open O, compose the section-normalized tensor-pullback adjunction with the open-restriction adjunction [def-pc-module-pullback], and use left-adjoint uniqueness to get an isomorphism e from the restricted pullback to the pullback along O.ι followed by a. The unit identity proves its normalization on every module section. Define cO as e.inv followed by the restriction of c and the differential restriction isomorphism [def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf]. The isomorphism identities give the commuting diagram. Naturality of c, its differential formula, and the unit identity for the differential restriction adjunction give the cO differential formula. No Cartesian hypothesis is used.

lean.statement: theorem etale_localization_relativeDifferentials {X₁ X₂ S₁ S₂ : Scheme.{u}} (a : X₂ ⟶ X₁) (b : S₂ ⟶ S₁) (f₁ : X₁ ⟶ S₁) (f₂ : X₂ ⟶ S₂) [Etale a] [Etale b] (h : a ≫ f₁ = f₂ ≫ b) : ∃ c : (Modules.tensorPullback a).obj f₁.relativeDifferentials ⟶ f₂.relativeDifferentials, IsIso c ∧ (∀ (W : X₁.Opens) (r : Γ(X₁, W)), c.app (a ⁻¹ᵁ W) (Modules.tensorPullbackSection a f₁.relativeDifferentials W (f₁.relativeDifferentialsDerivation.d (X := op W) r)) = f₂.relativeDifferentialsDerivation.d (X := op (a ⁻¹ᵁ W)) (a.app W r)) ∧ (∀ O : X₂.Opens, ∃ (e : ((Modules.tensorPullback a).obj f₁.relativeDifferentials).restrict O.ι ≅ (Modules.tensorPullback (O.ι ≫ a)).obj f₁.relativeDifferentials) (cO : (Modules.tensorPullback (O.ι ≫ a)).obj f₁.relativeDifferentials ⟶ (O.ι ≫ f₂).relativeDifferentials), (∀ (W : X₁.Opens) (m : Γ(f₁.relativeDifferentials, W)), e.hom.app (O.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (a ⁻¹ᵁ W)) (((Modules.tensorPullback a).obj f₁.relativeDifferentials).presheaf.map (homOfLE (O.ι.image_preimage_le (a ⁻¹ᵁ W))).op (Modules.tensorPullbackSection a f₁.relativeDifferentials W m)) = Modules.tensorPullbackSection (O.ι ≫ a) f₁.relativeDifferentials W m) ∧ (∀ (W : X₁.Opens) (r : Γ(X₁, W)), cO.app ((O.ι ≫ a) ⁻¹ᵁ W) (Modules.tensorPullbackSection (O.ι ≫ a) f₁.relativeDifferentials W (f₁.relativeDifferentialsDerivation.d (X := op W) r)) = (O.ι ≫ f₂).relativeDifferentialsDerivation.d (X := op ((O.ι ≫ a) ⁻¹ᵁ W)) ((O.ι ≫ a).app W r)) ∧ (Modules.restrictFunctor O.ι).map c ≫ (f₂.relativeDifferentialsRestrictIso O.ι).hom = e.hom ≫ cO)
